## Run

You can launch the application by running:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
draft::run_app()
```

## Season

The draft's target season comes from `NBA_DRAFT_SEASON` (default `"2026-27"`),
independent of the league dashboard's `NBA_SEASON`; the stats season is the
season before it. Set the variable in the environment (or the draft's
`.deploy.env`) to roll the season without editing code.
